content: Current official source snapshots: Flotilla is broad community UX with NIP-29 rooms, threads, calendar, search, featured/library, notifications, zaps, Blossom, NIP-17 DMs, NIP-07/55/46; Nostrord is focused NIP-29 chat with invites, roles/moderation, replies/reactions/media, notifications, NIP-07/46 and current NIP-55 code but no broad timeline/long-form surface; Jumble is relay-feed/public-social UX with community relay presets, chronological feeds, NIP-23 rendering, reactions, notifications, NIP-50 search, Blossom, NIP-07/46 but no NIP-29 group implementation found. Cross-checked official docs and repos at 2026-07-29/30 commits.
